cards.summary: Copies the selected layers or content to the clipboard.
cards.but: The result depends on whether you have layers, pixels, paths or text selected. A pixel selection can limit what is copied.

cards.summary: Select a layer, enter Free Transform, and drag a corner to resize it.
cards.but: Press Return to apply or Esc to cancel. Transforming a raster layer can change its image quality.

cards.summary: Copies the selected layer to a new layer.
cards.but: With an active pixel selection, only that area is copied. Cmd+D in Photoshop means Deselect.

cards.summary: Selects the Move tool to reposition the active layer or selection.
cards.but: Which layer moves depends on the selected layer and the Auto-Select setting.

cards.summary: Selects the Type tool. Click for point text or drag a text box.
cards.but: Tool groups remember the last tool used; Shift+T cycles through the Type tools with default settings.

cards.summary: Selects the Pen tool group for drawing paths or vector shapes.
cards.but: Check Path or Shape mode in the options bar. The tool group remembers its last tool.

cards.summary: Puts the selected layers into a group in the Layers panel.
Fits the document in the Photoshop window.
cards.but: Fits the document canvas rather than the bounds of all Figma objects.

cards.summary: Shows or hides the document rulers.
Photoshop has no direct equivalent to Figma auto layout.
cards.noMatchAlternative: Use the Move tool's Align and Distribute controls for selected layers.
